samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>Traffic light controller with pedestrian request handling.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Pedestrian request signal.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit output representing the count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red light signal.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow light signal.</output>
        <output id="green">Green light signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum name="idle">0</enum>
        <enum name="s1_red">1</enum>
        <enum name="s2_yellow">2</enum>
        <enum name="s3_green">3</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width="8">Internal counter for timing.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width="2">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Previous red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Previous yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Previous green signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= s1_red;
                cnt <= 8'd10;
                p_red <= 1'b0;
                p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                p_green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    s1_red: begin
                        red <= 1'b1;
                        yellow <= 1'b0;
                        green <= 1'b0;
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            cnt <= 8'd60;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        red <= 1'b0;
                        yellow <= 1'b1;
                        green <= 1'b0;
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            cnt <= 8'd3;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        red <= 1'b0;
                        yellow <= 1'b0;
                        green <= 1'b1;
                        if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            cnt <= 8'd5;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
                if (pass_request && green) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end
                if (!green && p_green) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd60;
                end
                if (!yellow && p_yellow) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd5;
                end
                if (!red && p_red) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end
                cnt <= cnt - 1;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                red <= 1'b0;
                yellow <= 1'b0;
                green <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                red <= p_red;
                yellow <= p_yellow;
                green <= p_green;
            end
        end

        assign clock = cnt;
    </implementation>
</module>
